clauses.title: CL-D94 records the gate launch's bound and what it does not change
clauses.section: ## CL-D94 — Every gate launch carries a 60-minute bound
requires: `build_gate_launch` emits `timeoutMs: 3600000` beside the fields CL-D68 fixed, for every gate in every workflow and mode
It emits no `checkpointBeforeDeadlineMs`: a gate is read-only and its result is all-or-nothing
Another bound, a checkpoint request on a gate launch, or a bound that varies by gate or diff requires a new owner decision

clauses.title: The writer's launch record names the gate bound beside its own
clauses.section: ## CL-D81 — The exact-autofix writer launch is composed by a packaged builder
requires: CL-D94 later gave every gate launch the same `timeoutMs` under its own decision, with no checkpoint request.

clauses.title: Every review-only gate launch carries the bound and no checkpoint
requires: Issue #111 build_gate_launch composes the request from the package and cannot carry another schema, an output file, or envelope prose

clauses.title: The receiver declares and keeps the gate bound
requires: Issue #159 the receiver accepts the cwd the gate launch now carries
